blockers.title: The magic link never signs in: the address is stripped of ?code before the Supabase client reads it
blockers.evidence: src/backup/session.ts startBackupAtLaunch calls takeLinkFromAddress() (strips code/error, history.replaceState) before resumeBackup(), the first caller of supabase(); auth-js _initialize then reads window.location.href without the code (GoTrueClient.js:389-403). No PKCE exchange; the app shows 'Il link è scaduto, già usato o aperto in un altro browser' for a valid same-browser link. Scratch run with a fake backend, as shipped: requests [POST /auth/v1/otp] only, no session. Control with the strip disabled: [POST /auth/v1/otp, POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=pkce, GET /rest/v1/courses, POST /rest/v1/courses], session stored. Regression from the SP-B3-6/FUX-B3-4 fix; no spec opened a ?code= link with a real verifier.
blockers.reproduction: Scratch pkce.spec.ts (pixel-7-chrome, fake backend, synthetic address): create a course, send the link from Impostazioni (stores the verifier), goto about:blank then '/?code=<uuid>', wait 10 s. Expected: token?grant_type=pkce and a signed-in device. Observed: no token request, 'link scaduto' notice.

importantFindings.title: An upload already in flight sends the first account's remaining rows with the second account's token (check-then-use in the connector)
importantFindings.evidence: src/backup/connector.ts uploadData checks the session's account once, then each request reads the current stored session. With Esci and another account's sign-in finishing during a held write (2 tabs, fake backend, synthetic students): WRITES [POST /rest/v1/courses Bearer tok-1, POST /rest/v1/students Bearer tok-2 x3]; after a plain sign-out a write went with the publishable key only. On the real backend the child-table policies refuse these rows (account 2 does not own the course, which is always the first entry), but the row contents reach the server under the wrong identity. Fix: pin the transaction's access token.

qolFindings.title: The persisted sign-in address outlives its one-hour validity
qolFindings.evidence: linkSentTo ignores an expired entry but never removes it; the address stays in localStorage on a shared phone if sign-in is never completed.

qolFindings.title: Esci offline with an expired token takes about 30 s before it completes
qolFindings.evidence: auth-js retries the refresh inside signOut; forgetStoredSession runs in finally. Correct result, but the screen may look stuck.
qolFindings.reproduction: Live spec 'signing out offline with an expired session stays signed out' takes 30.5 s.
